references.title: PMK 168/2023
references.quote: Art.10(2) and the Lampiran worked examples cap biaya jabatan at Rp500,000 for each month worked in the tax year ("maksimal 4 X Rp500.000,00" for a September joiner). Art.10(1)(b): the employee's own contribution to an OJK-approved pension fund reduces the year's gross like JHT and JP. Art.10(1)(c): zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer is deducted. Art.15(3): where the subjective tax obligation starts after January or ends before December (tax_subject_from, tax_subject_until), the net income is annualised (× 12 / months) and the tax prorated (× months / 12); the month the subject status ends is the last tax period. Art.12(2)(b), 16(2)(b) and Lampiran III.1.5(b): a daily worker above Rp2,500,000 a day is taxed at the art.17(1)(a) rates on 50% of each day's gross. Art.1: a pegawai tetap includes one on a fixed-term contract (PKWT) receiving regular income, who has the December/exit reckoning; a monthly-paid PART_TIME or DAILY worker uses monthly TER without a December reckoning. Art.1(11): a worker paid by the day, hour, unit or task, or part-time, is non-permanent and records pph21_payment_cadence. MONTHLY uses monthly TER on the month's wages (art.12(2)(c)). NON_MONTHLY divides the wages by the days worked: 0% through Rp450,000 and 0.5% through Rp2,500,000 on the whole (PP 58/2023 Lampiran D; art.16(2)(a)), or art.17 on 50% of the average day, by the days, above it (art.16(2)(b), Lampiran IV.1.3–4). A married female employee takes TK/0 unless she holds a written local-government statement at least at kecamatan level that her husband has no income. PTKP facts are read as at 1 January, or the first of the arrival month for a new resident (art.9(4)–(5)): a ptkp_standings entry of exactly that date wins, two refuse, and without one the run reads the contract in force, because a run sees no earlier contract. Owner rule 2026-10-22: PPh 21 is owed on the month's gross, so a payment made before the month's salary run is withheld at what it adds to the month; the TER rate is a flat rate on the month's whole gross and the December/exit reckoning is progressive, so an off-cycle THR or bonus paid first is withheld at the month's bracket, not at the bracket of the bonus alone.

references.quote: The PPh 21 of a Bukan Pegawai — an individual paid for services outside employment (expert, consultant, contractor, a commissioner not on the payroll) — is the art.17(1)(a) rates on 50% of the gross of each payment (art.12(3)); the gross is the whole fee, less materials or third-party costs the payee is reimbursed for (art.12(4)(b)). Each payment is taxed on its own (no cumulation). A non-resident payee is PPh 26 instead.

references.title: UU 36/2008 (PPh)
references.quote: 20% more without a validated tax number.

description: Income tax on fees paid to an individual who is not an employee: the yearly rates on 50% of each payment, and 20% more without a valid tax number (PMK 168/2023 art.12).

references.title: UU 36/2008 (PPh)
references.quote: Remuneration for work paid to a non-resident individual (present under 183 days in twelve months, art.2(4)) is withheld at 20% of the gross amount, final, subject to a tax treaty; PPh 21 does not apply. A missing tax registration does not waive withholding: art.21(1) puts the withholding on the payer, and art.21(5a) answers a recipient without an NPWP with a rate 20% higher, not with no tax.

references.title: PMK 168/2023
references.quote: 20% final, or the treaty rate where the non-resident gives the certificate of domicile.

description: Income tax on pay to a non-resident: 20% of the gross amount, final, or the tax treaty rate where a certificate of domicile is held (UU 36/2008 art.26; PMK 168/2023 art.14).

employer_amount:
const rate = get(ctx.subject.employer, 'entity_extension_data.dkptka_usd_idr_rate', null);
return rate == null ? 0 : ctx.lookup.monthly_usd * Number(rate);

references.title: PP 34/2021
references.quote: The DKPTKA is the compensation an employer pays for each foreign worker, non-tax state revenue or regional revenue; USD 100 per position per month, paid in advance for the period worked (Kemnaker tariff; secondary). Employer-only. Exempt positions: government bodies, diplomats, and the others the tariff exempts.

description: The monthly compensation an employer pays for employing a foreign worker: USD 100 for each position, converted at the company's recorded exchange rate. Paid by the employer only (PP 34/2021).

references.title: PP68/2009 art.6; PMK16/PMK.03/2010 art.5
references.locator: art.5(1)–(3); benefit first payment year plus two or later
references.quote: Apply one annual progressive ladder to the gross non-final severance and pension/THT/JHT instalments, with no PTKP or employment-expense deduction; invalid NPWP/NIK adds20%. Only native documented origins and due/payment dates in the same tax month are supported. Same-year ordinary employee/nonemployee income, active employment, negative corrections and missing/external opening evidence refuse.

references.title: PP 68/2009 arts.2(2),5–7: first two calendar years aggregate; year three onward is non-final. With no part paid in an earlier year, this payment's year is the first; an earlier part needs first_payment_year recorded.

description: Income tax on severance or pension instalments paid from the third year after the first payment: the yearly rates on the gross amount, with no personal allowance, and 20% more without a valid tax number (PP 68/2009 art.6).

eligibility:
if (get(ctx.subject.employment, 'terms.employer_bears_income_tax', false) !== true) return false;
return Number(get(ctx.statutory, 'PPH21.employee', 0)) + Number(get(ctx.statutory, 'PPH21_DTP.employee', 0)) !== 0;

references.title: UU 7/1983 on Income Tax as amended by UU 7/2021 (HPP), art.21(1)(a); PMK 168/2023 art.5
references.locator: art.21(1)(a): the employer withholds and pays PPh 21 on employment income; the employment agreement decides who bears it

description: Where the contract says the employer bears the income tax, moves the month's PPh 21 from the employee to the employer, except the share that falls on the pay items the contract leaves with the employee.
